name: burnrate-vscode
description: Your Claude Code usage limits and today's cost in the VS Code status bar. Local-only.

burnrate.refreshSeconds.description: How often to re-read usage, in seconds. Plan limits also update as soon as Claude Code reports new ones.

burnrate.showTodayCost.description: Show today's Claude Code cost (API list-price equivalent) in the status bar.

burnrate.dashboardCommand.description: Command that starts the dashboard, e.g. "burnrate dashboard". Leave empty to use the BurnRate install that `burnrate init claude-code` set up.

scripts.package: pnpm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --out burnrate-vscode.vsix
